title: Maximum lumbar and hip movements in forward/backward bending, side bending and twisting
condition: healthy, standing, maximal trunk movements in 3 planes

quantity.name: maximum lumbar and hip movement
quantity.definition: Lumbar = L1 sensor relative to sacral sensor; hip = thigh sensor relative to sacral sensor (hip-joint angle, NOT pelvis vs global). Lumbar: flexion, left lateral flexion, left axial rotation positive; hip: flexion, abduction, lateral rotation positive. Signed values (sign convention above).

source.sample: 20 healthy young males, no back/leg pain in previous 12 months

protocol.summary: Mean (SD) maximum lumbar and left/right hip angles for 6 trunk movements (Fig 1, digitised).
how_to_use: Forward bending: lumbar ~58 deg, hips ~55-57 deg flexion; backward bending: lumbar ~16 deg, hips ~9-11 deg extension.
Lateral bending: lumbar ~20-22 deg with hips < 6 deg (ab/adduction).
Twisting: lumbar axial rotation only 8-10 deg, hips 23-31 deg internal/external rotation: drive axial-rotation tasks mainly through the hips/pelvis.

measurement.device: 3SPACE Fastrak (Polhemus): sensors on L1 spinous process, sacrum, lateral left and right thighs; 30 Hz per sensor
measurement.posture: standing, feet shoulder-width (zero = comfortable upright posture)
measurement.task: 3 continuous cycles of max forward-backward bending, left-right lateral bending, left-right twisting, 12 s per trial at comfortable speed; repeated 3 times

protocol.notes: Hip rotations in twisting have large SD (12-21 deg).

extraction.uncertainty: means +-1 deg, SDs +-1.5 deg (200 dpi, 3.35 px/deg, bar edges and error-bar ends by pixel scan)
extraction.check_notes: Axis calibrated on 8 ticks (80 to -60). Re-digitised right lateral bending after legend-box contamination (first pass gave spurious 48.5). Bar values visually confirmed on rendered image; right-lateral-bending right-hip SD 6.6 from cap at 11.2.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
